reuse.why: Extends the existing shared link guard used by every provider's link function and extracts the unlink field-clearing from unlinkAccount into clearBankLink, which both paths now use.

duplication.why: The detach logic is shared with unlinkAccount instead of copied, and the flag is handled once in the shared guard; per-provider edits are just parameter pass-through.

placement.why: The rule lives in the single pre-link helper in accounts/app.ts that all six provider link functions already call, and the flag is added to the shared LinkAccountBaseParams type.

scope.why: Only the flag, the helper extraction, the pass-through at each link function and tests.

maintainability.why: Clean and single-sourced, though the renamed prepareBankAccountLink now mixes validation with a side-effecting unlink, which a maintainer has to notice.
